title: Zeroth Fitting ideal of a finitely generated module
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $P$ a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Choose a finite free surjection $\pi:R^{\oplus n}\twoheadrightarrow P$ and define $I_0(P):=I_0(\pi)$, the ideal generated by the $n\times n$ kernel-row determinants [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change]. This ideal is independent of the chosen finite free surjection by [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change].
